BUYING & PROJECT PLANNING

Custom Drinkware & Accessories: Buyer Questions

Direct answers about selection, quotes, samples, documentation and enquiry handling, with links to related models and buying guides.

Prepare a Project Enquiry →

Who is the factory operator?

The operator identified for this website is Shenzhen Baoyuanfeng Precision Machining Co., Ltd. Its core business is silicone and plastic processing; shakers and bottle openers are additional product lines. Confirm the production and supply arrangement for your selected model.

Read More →

Can I enquire without a complete specification?

Yes. Send a model or reference, intended use, estimated quantity and destination. Identify undecided items, then agree the final material, components, dimensions and artwork before production approval.

Read More →

What is the minimum order quantity?

Minimum order and price depend on the selected model, specification, decoration and packing. Request a project quote; no single minimum or selling price is promised across all models.

Read More →

What should the quotation list separately?

Ask the quote to identify unit price and any applicable artwork, setup, sample, tooling, packing or delivery charges. Whether a charge applies and how it is calculated must be confirmed for the project.

Read More →

Which specifications are customized for folding cups and coasters?

Folding-cup capacity, open dimensions and folded dimensions are specified to project requirements. Coaster dimensions are also customized; capacity is not applicable to a coaster. Agree the reference shape and final specification.

Read More →

What should I compare for LED drinkware?

Compare the body and light component separately: light mode, activation, power, supplied parts, contact conditions and cleaning. A glow or UV-reactive name does not automatically mean LED. FGB-015 is recorded as UV-reactive.

Read More →

What is confirmed for electric wine openers?

The factory confirmed aluminum/ABS components and PD power supply for KPQ-008 through KPQ-021. Connector, voltage, wattage, runtime, kit contents and operating requirements still need model-specific confirmation.

Read More →

Can I order cup stickers or transfer decals separately?

Yes, separate supply is factory-confirmed. Share the cup material, surface, artwork and application method so the decoration and sample can be reviewed for the project.

Read More →

Does every model have the same documentation?

No universal documentation claim is made. Material, components, decoration, intended use and destination affect which records are relevant. Ask which records are available for the selected specification.

Read More →

What evidence can I request before approving an order?

Ask about operator details, material records, existing test reports, sample and inspection records. Match each record to the actual model, material, supplied components, date and scope. Availability is reviewed for the project.

Read More →

Are images actual factory or customer-order photographs?

No. Images marked as are visual illustrations. They do not prove a workshop layout, installed equipment, capacity or completed order. Ask about actual project-relevant photos and samples where available.

Read More →

Can I review a sample before a bulk order?

Discuss an existing-model sample, decorated sample or pre-production sample. Agree the specification, charges, preparation time, shipping and approval points in writing. A digital artwork proof does not replace a physical sample.

Read More →

How are delivery responsibilities and dates agreed?

State the required arrival date and destination. Agree production completion, transit assumptions, named delivery terms, place and responsibilities in the quote. No universal shipping method or tax arrangement is assumed.

Read More →

Are all cups dishwasher-safe or suitable for hot drinks?

No such universal claim is made. Review the exact body, lid, straw, decoration and light component for the intended drink, temperature and cleaning method.

Read More →

How are enquiry files handled?

Contact details, project requirements and uploaded files go to the website receiving service for follow-up. Send only authorized files. Contact the project email with your enquiry reference for submission questions or a removal request.

Read More →

Does a saved enquiry mean an email has been delivered?

No. Website storage and email forwarding are separate states. Keep the returned enquiry reference. Email forwarding is not configured in this preview, so storage confirmation is not email-delivery confirmation.

Read More →

Make the Next Step Specific

Share the model, use, estimated quantity, artwork, destination and required arrival date. Identify any items you have not decided.
